Container.Name: media-server-dashboard
Container.Overview: A dashboard for a homelab media stack plus a 3D office where your apps are the staff. Radarr, Sonarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, SABnzbd, NZBGet, qBittorrent, rdtclient and Jellyfin; a live feed from their webhooks with a team board, long-term statistics, a start page with your own links, and a full screen mode for wall tablets. Without a Proxmox host it shows the Unraid server itself: CPU, memory, load, disk activity and the free space of the mounted shares.[br][br]After the first start, open the WebUI and enter the setup token from the container's log (Docker tab → the container's icon → Logs).

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: The dashboard's port. Change the left (host) side if 8900 is taken on your server.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Settings, password hash, API keys, the live feed, the team board and the statistics.

Config.Name: Shares (free space)
Config.Description: Optional, read-only: the dashboard shows how full the array is. Remove it if you don't want that.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the dashboard runs as; 99 is Unraid's nobody, the owner of appdata.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the dashboard runs as; 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Only behind a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Traefik): its address or range as the container sees it, e.g. 172.16.0.0/12. Then the login lockout sees the real visitor and the cookie is marked secure.

Config.Name: Host name
Config.Description: Optional: the name shown for this server. Empty: the Unraid server's name.
